# tags

Tags on resources.

- Toolset name: `tags`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 6 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_clone_tag`

**Clone tag** · mutating

Clone a tag. Returns the UUID of the copy.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_create_tag`

**Create tag** · mutating

Create a tag, optionally attached to one resource. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | boolean | no | Whether the tag is active |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Tag name, e.g. "owner" or "env:prod" |
| `resource_id` | string | no | UUID of the resource to attach to |
| `resource_type` | string | no | Type of the resource to attach to, e.g. "task", "target", "host" |
| `value` | string | no | Tag value |

### `openvas_delete_tag`

**Delete tag** · destructive

Delete a tag (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_tag`

**Get tag** · read-only

Get one tag by UUID, including the resources it is attached to.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_tags`

**List tags** · read-only

List tags attached to GVM resources.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_update_tag`

**Update tag** · destructive

Update a tag's value, attachment or active flag. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | boolean | no |  |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the tag to update |
| `resource_id` | string | no |  |
| `resource_type` | string | no |  |
| `value` | string | no |  |
